sources.fact: LBBD15/BZ at 174-176 Ripple Road is 0.04ha, 9 minimum/maximum net dwellings and planning-permission-status permissioned.
The current Brownfield entry records full planning permission dated 21 December 2016 and planning-history id 14046.
The current Brownfield entry has a point and blank geometry; this is not treated as an application red-line or legal title polygon.
Ownership status not-owned-by-a-public-authority does not identify a proprietor or HMLR title.
Planning Committee application 15/00427/FUL sought a 3/4/5-storey building with ground-floor retail and 9 flats at 174-176 Ripple Road.
The Board granted planning permission subject to completion of a Section 106 agreement and conditions; committee grant is kept distinct from legal title evidence.
The committee record describes 1 studio, 4 one-bedroom, 3 two-bedroom and 1 three-bedroom unit, totalling 9 flats.
Planning Data's older brownfield-site dataset contains an LBBD15 multipolygon for 174-176 Ripple Road; this is historical register geometry, not an HMLR title polygon.
LBBD states all sites on its Brownfield Land Register require planning permission.
LBBD's Local Plan 2037 was adopted on 18 September 2024 and is policy evidence, not parcel-title evidence.
The Development Plan is used when assessing planning applications and does not replace case-specific or title evidence.
LBBD separates planning policy, Brownfield Register information and planning-application decision making; these are not collapsed into an ownership/title conclusion.

examples.result: BZ remains a 9-home permissioned Brownfield candidate.
15/00427/FUL is exact committee evidence for 9 flats at 174-176 Ripple Road.
Committee grant subject to S106 is not converted into title ownership evidence.
The historic LBBD15 brownfield polygon is not treated as an HMLR title polygon.
Current Brownfield point/blank geometry is not buffered into a synthetic site boundary.
Non-public ownership category is not proprietor identification.
The 9-unit mix reconciles exactly to the committee total without adding neighbouring schemes.
Promotion remains zero until exact current parcel/title relation and statutory overlays are verified.
